subject: Operational playbook and isolation evidence for on-prem / air-gapped deployment
messages:
From: Tom Roberts <tom.roberts@solsticehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Isolation deployment: operational scenarios & evidence request

David / Laura / Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As part of our procurement evaluation we need concrete operational scenarios and evidence to validate that Redwood can be operated inside our air-gapped sites. Specifically we would like:

- A concise operator playbook describing day-1 install, upgrades, and emergency rollback steps (we expect runbook form).
- Network connectivity diagrams showing egress points, optional proxy patterns, and required outbound exceptions if any.
- Telemetry/telemetry-neutrality approach (what logs leave the isolated environment, if any).
- Proof of supply-chain attestation showing vendor patch process and SBOM handling.

Can you provide those items and indicate any operator privileges we need to maintain on customer-side VMs? We are targeting an internal review the week of Aug 2 — ideally we would have material by Aug 1.

Also: would you be able to run a short operator training (90 min) for our infra team the week after the review?

Appreciate it — feel free to send links or a secure bundle.

Thanks,
Tom Roberts
Director, IT Security
Solstice Health
security@solsticehealth.com

---


From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Roberts <tom.roberts@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolation deployment: operational scenarios & evidence request

Tom —

Thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely support the items you requested. High-level notes up front:

- Operator playbook: we have an operator-facing PDF runbook that covers install (air-gapped bundle install via USB image or customer-side repository), operator credentialing, patching, and rollback procedures. We will provide a redacted version suitable for your procurement review and a full version under NDA if needed.
- Network diagrams: Redwood private packages can be installed with zero outbound egress if you elect a fully air-gapped bundle. Alternatively we support a minimal outbound pattern (TLS to specific endpoints) for telemetry aggregation; both options are documented.
- Telemetry: by default telemetry is disabled in fully air-gapped installs. For customers who enable limited telemetry we provide a telemetry filter and customer-side collectors; logs are written to local storage by default.
- Supply-chain/SBOM: we can provide a signed SBOM and our vendor patch cadence; we also include instructions for offline patch ingestion.

I am attaching a sanitized operator playbook and a network evidence summary. I will also share a secure Drive folder with the attestation documents (link below).

We can schedule the 90-minute operator training on Aug 4 or Aug 6; I can lead the session with Laura covering security controls and Irene walking through operator tasks. What time window works best for your team?

Attached: operator-playbook-v1.3.pdf, network-evidence-summary.csv
Secure folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleSecureFolder

Regards,
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0134

From: Tom Roberts <tom.roberts@solsticehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, security@solsticehealth.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolation deployment: operational scenarios & evidence request

David — thanks, this is helpful. Quick follow-ups after a first pass with our infra team:

1) Can you confirm whether any service accounts are required to be created in our environment that have outbound permissions? If so list exact OAuth scopes / token lifetimes.
2) For the offline patch ingestion: we want a short example manifest and checksum verification steps included in the runbook (to validate integrity for auditors). Can you add that to the full runbook?
3) For operator training: Aug 4 at 10:00am PT works for our Ops leads. Please block 90 minutes.

Also — our procurement/legal team will likely request a supply-chain attestation PDF and a short statement on how you manage third-party components. Can you confirm if that attestation is signed by your security lead or CISO?

If you prefer, we can open a quick 30-minute call to walk the team through any gaps.

Tom
